QuestionStmt.S: A parallel plate air capacitor has capacitance $C_P$. It is equally filled with parallel layers of materials of dielectric constants $K_1$ and $K_2$. Now its capacity becomes $C_K$. The ratio $\frac{C_P}{C_K}$ is

Solution.S:
When two dielectric layers of equal thickness are placed in series between the plates, the equivalent dielectric constant is given by:

$$\frac{1}{K_{eq}} = \frac{1}{2K_1} + \frac{1}{2K_2} = \frac{K_1 + K_2}{2K_1 K_2}$$

$$K_{eq} = \frac{2K_1 K_2}{K_1 + K_2}$$

The new capacitance $C_K = K_{eq} \cdot C_P = \frac{2K_1 K_2}{K_1 + K_2} C_P$.

Thus $\frac{C_P}{C_K} = \frac{K_1 + K_2}{2K_1 K_2}$, which corresponds to option C.
